label: Malluch

text.BHSA NEH 12:1: וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָל֛וּ עִם־זְרֻבָּבֶ֥ל בֶּן־שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵ֖ל וְיֵשׁ֑וּעַ שְׂרָיָ֥ה יִרְמְיָ֖ה עֶזְרָֽא׃
text.KJV NEH 12:1: Now these are the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

A.name: Malluch
A.notes: named on the sealed document of NEH 10:1-27 (NEH 10:4)

B.name: Malluch
B.line: Priest who returned with Zerubbabel; his house head later called Melicu/Jonathan

why: The Hebrew heading in Nehemiah 12:1 identifies the following names, including מַלּוּךְ in 12:2, as priests and Levites who returned with Zerubbabel and Jeshua. This directly matches B’s stated identity; A is identified as a priest who signed the covenant in Nehemiah 10.
